## Batch 10 complete

The draft A/B pages contain **32 A items and 3 examples**. I added a choice-free finite KL proof and a choice-free conditional block-information lemma, then completed the LZ77 recurrence and inverse window-length proofs using Kac’s formula, SMB, and a conditional counting bound. The full independent treatment is in [Kontoyiannis’s dissertation](https://www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk/~ik355/PAPERS/thesis.pdf), Chapter 5.

All **35 item-level Step 1 records are ready**. Three page-level interfaces remain open for reconciliation: `iid-lossless-source-coding-and-the-aep` (batch 9), `prefix-codes-and-finite-lossless-coding` (batch 8), and `measure-theoretic-information-and-conditioning` (batch 5). Their supplier items, required hypotheses, and affected claims are recorded in the [cross-batch evidence](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-10.cross-batch-dependencies.json>).

## Checks

`manifest-deps`, scoped dependency levels, strict proof contracts, proof layout, coverage, and the batch 10 Step 1 hash audit passed. Proof layout found **0 defects across 35 items and 104 steps**. Coverage reported **0 errors and 0 warnings**; source fetch resolved all 13 records, with the inaccessible Wyner–Ziv article documented as dropped only as a proof source.

The run-wide batch dependency check is currently stale after the final manifest change; batch 10 still computes to **level 2, requiring batches 5, 8, and 9**. I left the shared level file for its owner. The run-wide item dependency and Step 1 audits also remain open on other batches’ empty inventories and records.

See the [A page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/information-theory/stationary-ergodic-sources-and-universal-coding.md>), [B page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/information-theory/stationary-ergodic-sources-and-universal-coding-examples.md>), [manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-10.pages.json>), [coverage evidence](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-10.coverage.json>), and [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-10.notes.md>).
